description: The pie chart in Figure 6 represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled as ENTITYQUEST (blue, approximately 26.0%), HOTPOTQA (red, approximately 24.2%), TRIVIAQA (yellow, approximately 22.7%), POPQA (green, approximately 21.6%), WEBQUESTIO (purple, approximately 3.6%), and TREC (teal, approximately 1.8%). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice and does not have a separate legend. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
